anthropic_economic_index.title: Anthropic Economic Index
anthropic_economic_index.license: CC-BY (release data documentation); dataset card lists MIT
anthropic_economic_index.description: Monthly Claude.ai usage by country and US state (share of global usage and per-capita index) and the global mix of request topics, from the Anthropic Economic Index releases on Hugging Face.
notes: release_2026_06_26 covers April 2026 and May 2026; snapshot shows May 2026: 121 countries, 52 US states.
Cells below Anthropic's aggregation thresholds are not published, so smaller countries are missing rather than zero.
Request-topic shares use hierarchy level 2 ('Major' topics); 1.33% of conversations fall in topics below the publication threshold and are shown as a remainder.

openai_usage_report.title: How People Use ChatGPT
openai_usage_report.publisher: OpenAI / NBER (Chatterji et al., Working Paper 34255)
openai_usage_report.license: Figures quoted from a published working paper; no dataset was released. Transcription, not redistribution.
openai_usage_report.description: Share of consumer ChatGPT messages by conversation topic, July 2025 versus July 2024, from a sample of about one million de-identified consumer messages (May 2024 - June 2025).
notes: Static transcription: no dataset exists, so this series changes only when the code is updated.
Sample: approximately 1.1 million sampled conversations, May 15, 2024 through June 26, 2025 (Figure 7 caption).

wikipedia_pageviews.title: Wikipedia pageviews for AI-assistant articles
wikipedia_pageviews.license: CC0 (Wikimedia Analytics pageview datasets are released under the Creative Commons CC0 dedication)
wikipedia_pageviews.description: Daily human pageviews of each assistant's Wikipedia article summed across language editions (Pageviews REST API), plus per-country sums from the differentially private country_project_page dataset, over the last 30 full days.
notes: Daily series: 436 language editions across 8 articles, agent=user, all-access, 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-22.
Country sums: 30 of 30 days available, 76 countries.

pypi_downloads.title: PyPI SDK downloads by country
pypi_downloads.publisher: Python Software Foundation (PyPI) via Google BigQuery public datasets
pypi_downloads.license: BigQuery public dataset bigquery-public-data.pypi (PyPI download statistics, published under the PSF's open data terms)
pypi_downloads.description: Downloads of the openai, anthropic, google-genai and mistralai Python packages by country over the last 7 complete days.

github_forks.title: GitHub SDK fork owners by city
github_forks.license: Public profile data via the GitHub API, subject to GitHub's Terms of Service; only aggregated counts are stored
github_forks.description: Self-reported profile locations of people who forked the official OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral and Meta Llama SDK repositories, geocoded offline to the globe's cities and to countries.
notes: 21886 fork owners enumerated (newest first, at most 6000 per repository); 7666 list a location.
Geocoding matched 42.2% of locations to a globe city and 87.5% to a country.
Organisations and users without a location are counted in forks_seen only.
